description: AI auto-edit effects manifest. Each entry describes an effect the auto-edit engine can place. Sound effects reference placeholder assets (synthesized via ffmpeg lavfi) - swap for real licensed audio later.

effects.name: Reaction Zoom
effects.useWhen: A strong audience/streamer reaction is detected (loud vocal burst corroborated by chat laugh or emotional face). Zooms toward the reacting person's face.

effects.name: Burst Caption
effects.useWhen: A sharp vocal emphasis or energy jump aligns with a transcript word - flash a short onomatopoeia/reaction word for comic effect.

burst.description: If true, scale-in then fade-out animation

effects.name: Comedic Stinger (ba-dum-tss)
effects.useWhen: After a funny moment's punchline lands, during a brief silence. Best for mood=funny clips.

effects.name: Crickets (Awkward Silence)
effects.useWhen: During an awkward silence after dialogue. Default fallback SFX.

effects.name: Whoosh (Transition)
effects.useWhen: Quick scene transition or fast movement. mood=impressive clips.

effects.name: Record Scratch (WTF moment)
effects.useWhen: Something unexpected or controversial. mood=controversial clips.

effects.name: Tension Riser
effects.useWhen: Building anticipation before an emotional payoff. mood=emotional clips.
